data.gender_notes: Hudaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Hudaa is a name that signifies guidance and light. It is derived from the Arabic word ‘hudaa’ meaning 'guidance' or 'direction'. The name is mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to the guidance of Allah. The name Hudaa carries the meaning “Guide, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hudaa usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Hudaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hudaa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
